posts.excerpt: ORR's timeline says the 1-year-old was never in immigration court alone: he and his 17-year-old mother were encountered near Naco, Arizona, on June 25, and she accompanied him to every proceeding.…
posts.body: ORR's [timeline](https://foxnews.com/politics/fed-timeline-challenges-reports-migrant-baby-facing-immigration-judge-alone) says the 1-year-old was never in immigration court alone: he and his 17-year-old mother were encountered near Naco, Arizona, on June 25, and she accompanied him to every proceeding. The agency pins the July 8 gap on contractor Acacia, which completed legal orientation on July 1 but never filed the E28 notice of appearance.

posts.title: Four-minute daily workout lifted older adults' strength and balance
posts.excerpt: A Penn State randomized trial put 97 relatively inactive adults, average age 74, on a daily four-minute bodyweight routine for 12 weeks (Men's Journal). Against the control group they completed 4.2…
posts.body: A Penn State randomized trial put 97 relatively inactive adults, average age 74, on a daily four-minute bodyweight routine for 12 weeks ([Men's Journal](https://www.mensjournal.com/health/scientists-found-a-4-minute-daily-workout-that-could-improve-longevity-after-65)). Against the control group they completed 4.2 more chair stands in 30 seconds, though the authors caution the study measured physical performance rather than actual falls.

posts.title: Senators tell HHS to drop in-house UAC lawyers
posts.excerpt: HHS has until October 30 to confirm in writing that none of its own attorneys will represent an unaccompanied child in immigration court, under a letter led by Senator Tammy Duckworth and signed by…
posts.body: HHS has until October 30 to confirm in writing that none of its own attorneys will represent an unaccompanied child in immigration court, under [a letter led by Senator Tammy Duckworth](https://immigration-analytics.com/2026/10/20/hhs-unaccompanied-children-lawyers/) and signed by five other Democratic senators. The letter targets the Unaccompanied Alien Children Legal Representation Division that HHS created inside its Office of the General Counsel on September 29, arriving as the nonprofit lawyer network covering more than 20,000 children has largely stopped since its contract expired July 31.

posts.title: Google open-sources TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend for TPUs
posts.excerpt: Google has open-sourced TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend that makes its TPUs a first-class hardware target alongside GPUs and CPUs, built with Meta's PyTorch team and announced at PyTorch…
posts.body: Google has [open-sourced TorchTPU](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/science/google-takes-on-nvidia-with-new-ai-developer-tool/story), a native PyTorch backend that makes its TPUs a first-class hardware target alongside GPUs and CPUs, built with Meta's PyTorch team and announced at PyTorch Conference 2026. The bet is on switching costs: Amazon shipped its own no-rewrite port, TorchNeuron, the same week, so the GPU default now has two funded exits.

posts.title: Protein plus lifting beat lifting alone in 23-trial review
posts.excerpt: Pooling 23 randomized trials in 611 young adults, a Frontiers in Nutrition meta-analysis published October 13 found lifters adding protein gained 7.40 kg more on their squat than lifters training…
posts.body: Pooling 23 randomized trials in 611 young adults, [a Frontiers in Nutrition meta-analysis](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/nutrition/articles/10.3389/fnut.2026.1946052/full) published October 13 found lifters adding protein gained 7.40 kg more on their squat than lifters training without it. The edge showed up mainly when lifters took protein both around their workouts and before sleep.
